name: OrioneScaleBLE
description: AcaiaArduinoBLE v4.0.2 (rancilio-pid/AcaiaArduinoBLE, 9afd589) with fixes for the Orione build: no NimBLE stack reset while no scale is around (heap leak), clients handed back to NimBLE, callbacks detached before they are deleted. Only the esp32_round_* envs use it; the others keep the upstream library.
